title: CTET February 2026 Certificate Download
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://ctet.nic.in
2. Open CTET Certificate / DigiLocker link
3. Login with roll number and DOB
4. Download CTET Eligibility Certificate
5. Also check DigiLocker for digital document
shortDescription: CTET February 2026 Certificate Download – get eligibility certificate from ctet.nic.in / DigiLocker after result.
content:
CBSE CTET issues eligibility certificates to candidates who qualify Paper-I and/or Paper-II.

After February 2026 result declaration, download the certificate from ctet.nic.in or via DigiLocker. CTET certificate is valid as per NCTE / CBSE rules for teacher recruitment.
